districtFact: Beaverton School District publishes two different 2026-2027 schedules: the main district calendar has 174 student days, while the Pre-K and Preschool Promise calendar has 135 student days, begins September 8, and has no school on Fridays. The district also publishes its main calendar in ten translated editions and identifies major cultural and religious dates when schools should avoid important events and tests.

about.title: About the Beaverton School District Calendar
about.content: Beaverton School District serves students in and around Beaverton in Washington County, Oregon. Its year-at-a-glance calendar identifies districtwide student days, closures, staff workdays, grading days, semester endings, senior dates, and potential June make-up days. Individual schools still publish events and grade-specific opening details that do not appear on the district PDF.

about.title: The Printed First Day Has a Grade-Level Caveat
about.content: The district calendar marks one first day for students but states that the date may be modified by grade level. Families should use the district date as the broad opening marker, then follow their school's communication for kindergarten meetings, orientation, split attendance, or another grade-specific first-week schedule.

about.title: Pre-K Uses a Separate Four-Day Calendar
about.content: BSD's Pre-K and Preschool Promise program does not follow every date on the main district calendar. Its 2026-2027 calendar lists 135 student days, no school on Fridays, a September 8 first day, and a June 10 last day. English and Spanish Pre-K PDFs are published separately from the multilingual district calendars.

about.title: June Dates Are Conditional, Not an Automatic Extension
about.content: The district schedules a last day for students and then reserves a later June week as potential make-up school days. Those dates are used only if weather or another emergency closure leaves BSD short of the instructional hours required by the Oregon Department of Education.

about.title: Cultural Observances Are Scheduling Protections
about.content: BSD's calendar marks Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Diwali, Christmas, Lunar New Year, Easter, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha as major cultural and religious dates. These are not all automatic school closures; the district asks schools to avoid important events and tests and provides accommodation guidance for student absences.

planningTips.title: Beaverton School District Calendar Notes
content: Treat the district's printed first day as the broad opening date, then confirm kindergarten and other grade-specific arrangements with the student's school.
Use the separate Pre-K calendar for Preschool Promise planning; the program has 135 student days and no Friday classes in 2026-2027.
Plan for the full Monday-through-Friday Fall Break and Spring Break windows shown on the district calendar.
Do not assume a grading day or staff-development day is available for student attendance; both are marked as no-student days.
Keep the potential June make-up week flexible until BSD confirms whether any dates are needed.
Use BSD's live calendar and school messages for event times, grade-level openings, and revisions after downloading a static PDF or ICS file.
Check the district's cultural and religious observances page before scheduling a major family-school event; observed dates are not the same as districtwide closures.

districtFaqs.q: When does Beaverton School District start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: The district calendar lists Tuesday, August 25, 2026, as the first day for students. BSD notes that first-day dates may be modified by grade level, so families should confirm kindergarten and other opening details with their school.

districtFaqs.q: When does Beaverton Pre-K start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: The separate BSD Pre-K and Preschool Promise calendar starts Tuesday, September 8, 2026. It has 135 student days, no school on Fridays, and a last day of June 10, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: When is the last day of Beaverton School District in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for students is Thursday, June 10, 2027. June 14-18 are potential make-up school days and only become attendance days if BSD needs them to recover instructional hours.

districtFaqs.q: When is Beaverton School District Fall Break in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

districtFaqs.q: Are BSD cultural and religious observances school closures?
districtFaqs.a: Not automatically. BSD identifies major observances when schools should avoid important events and tests, but families should use the district calendar's school-closure markings to determine whether classes are canceled.

districtFaqs.q: Does Beaverton School District publish translated calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. For 2026-2027, BSD publishes district calendars in Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, Dari, Japanese, Korean, Pashto, Russian, Somali, and Vietnamese, plus separate English and Spanish Pre-K calendars.
